name: Binary Grid Ray Traversal (Single Voxel Step)
definition: A GPU kernel function that advances a ray through a single voxel in a binary occupancy grid. It determines which axis (X, Y, or Z) the ray exits the current voxel through by comparing the distances to the next boundary on each axis, updates the current voxel index and the distance to the next boundary, and returns false if the ray has exited the valid grid bounds (overflow).
